newsitem.title: USA: Group raises Laser Industries stake.
newsitem.headline: Group raises Laser Industries stake.

text.p: A group including Trans-Resources Inc and Haifa Chemicals Ltd said it raised its stake in Laser Industries Ltd to the equivalent of 1,448,250 ordinary shares or 17.1 percent of the total outstanding.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 180,000 additional shares of Laser between October 19 to November 7 at prices ranging from $11.50 to $12.00 a share, totalling $2.15 million.
The group said its stake includes warrants to buy 250,000 shares of Laser at $5.75 a share. It said it holds the stake in the Tel-Aviv, Israel,-based maker of laser systems for investment purposes.
